d: @ZIGMA44 Thanks for the kind words on my last post. And thank you for the work you're doing. I'm trying to do as many stories by Asagi Ryu as I can, so stay tuned for more (his work is surprisingly deep, a second reading always brings out more layers you miss the first time through, that's especially true for this one with the psychology). Yes, I generally just check the comments once after I post to see if there are any corrections I missed. If you want to contact someone on e-hentai it's best to use the DM system. Click the letter icon next to a person's name to launch it.
